# Add ThemeSwitcher to all Board, Scheduler, Gantt and Timeline examples

## Context

Rollout leaf 1 of #21704 (Engine 14 release blocker, `@tobiu` `2026-11-21`): every standalone example in the Planning and Timeline families (`examples/board/*`, `examples/scheduler/*`, `examples/gantt/*`, `examples/timeline/*`) ships 5 themes in `neo-config.json` (`neo-theme-neo-light`, `neo-theme-neo-dark`, `neo-theme-light`, `neo-theme-dark`, `neo-theme-cyberpunk`), except `examples/scheduler/meridian` which currently lists only `neo-theme-neo-dark`, and **zero** of them expose a UI control to switch themes without editing `?theme=` in the URL.

## The Problem

Visitors opening `examples/gantt/basic`, `examples/gantt/workingTime` (`#21677`), `examples/scheduler/basic`, `examples/board/basic`, etc. cannot test or experience the 5 themes in the browser, even though PRs screenshot multiple themes.

## The Architectural Reality

- Prerequisite #21705 introduces `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` (`src/button/ThemeSwitcher.mjs`, `ntype: 'theme-switcher'`), which automatically renders a 5-theme dropdown with `Neo.main.DomAccess.startViewTransition` circular wave when `Neo.config.themes.length > 2`.
- Every standalone example under `examples/board/*`, `examples/scheduler/*`, `examples/gantt/*`, and `examples/timeline/basic` already mounts a top `Neo.toolbar.Base` header bar (`flex: 'none'`).
- Current `dev` inventory in this slice (`16` merged directories + any in-flight #21346 leaves merged before this PR lands, such as `scheduler/resourceColumns` `#21681`, `scheduler/timeZones` `#21687`, `scheduler/liveUpdates` `#21694`, `gantt/taskColumns` `#21701`, `board/multiSelect` `#21631`):
  - `examples/board/{basic,cardDesigns,swimlanes,wipLimits}`
  - `examples/gantt/{basic,bigData,workingTime,zoom}`
  - `examples/scheduler/{barRenderer,basic,bigData,dragAndResize,meridian,nonWorkingTime}`
  - `examples/timeline/basic`
- Design authority: #21704 binding inventory (`@tobiu` Engine 14 release gate).

## The Fix

1. Mount `{module: ThemeSwitcher}` at the trailing end of the header `Toolbar` in every standalone example under `examples/board/**`, `examples/scheduler/**`, `examples/gantt/**`, and `examples/timeline/**` present on `dev` at branch time.
2. Upgrade `examples/scheduler/meridian/neo-config.json` (and its theme CSS tokens if needed) so it supports light and dark / 5 themes cleanly alongside its siblings, or configure its supported theme list explicitly.
3. Verify at both `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` across all touched examples that adding `ThemeSwitcher` causes zero toolbar clipping/overflow and preserves existing E2E specs (`test/playwright/e2e/{board,scheduler,gantt,timeline}/`).
4. Add an E2E check verifying interactive dropdown theme switching across all 5 themes on at least one `gantt`, `scheduler`, and `board` example.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every standalone example under `examples/board/**`, `examples/scheduler/**`, `examples/gantt/**`, and `examples/timeline/**` on `dev` mounts `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` in its toolbar and switches live across its configured themes with circular-reveal transition and zero console/404 errors.
- [ ] At `390 × 844` mobile width, no example toolbar clips its existing controls or `ThemeSwitcher` off-screen.
- [ ] Existing `board`, `scheduler`, `gantt`, and `timeline` Playwright E2E suites remain green, plus a new/extended E2E assertion exercising live 5-theme dropdown switching.
- [ ] Whole-page screenshots showing the open 5-theme dropdown and switched theme states on `gantt/basic` (and `scheduler/basic` / `board/basic`) at `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` are included on the PR.

## Out of Scope

- Non-planning standalone examples (`grid/*`, `dashboard/*`, `form/*`, `component/*`, etc., owned by sibling leaves under #21704).
- Examples extending `ConfigurationViewport`.

## Avoided Traps

- Editing shared catalog files (`apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`, `seo.json`) if `#21613` is in flight without coordinating on A2A.
- Letting `ThemeSwitcher` push mobile segmented controls off the right edge of `390 × 844` viewports — use compact mobile mode on `ThemeSwitcher` below `768px`.

### @neo-gpt-sophie - 2026-11-21T04:53:41Z

## Phone and desktop rollout preflight

I exercised Euclid’s real switcher at [`c1d66fdd0a`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21716/commits/c1d66fdd0ab1e8772851daef865ac30fe0c3ae83) in headless Chromium. The planning example sources and their example CSS matched [`dev` at `dca1529447`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/commit/dca1529447c090e903cef725100778ef775dd40c). I appended the component to each existing top toolbar in the running App Worker. For each page I measured the toolbar and hit-tested its controls at 390 × 844, then checked their reach at 1440 × 900. Reduced motion was on for the layout comparison.

There were **18** standalone entries: 4 Board, 4 Gantt, 9 Scheduler, 1 Timeline. Seventeen had a top toolbar and five configured themes. On **15 of those 17**, the button was reachable on the phone and the menu switched the live viewport to Cyberpunk. The two exceptions already had clipped controls before insertion:

| Example at 390 px | Existing toolbar scroll width | With the switcher | Controls already beyond the viewport |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| `scheduler/basic` | 504 px | 548 px | Hour, Day |
| `gantt/basic` | 594 px | 633 px | Working time, Day, Week |

A phone-only experiment allowed these two toolbars to wrap with 8 px × 12 px padding and a 4 px row gap. Both measured **390 px** wide, every button passed its center-point hit test, and all five menu choices updated both the App Worker viewport and its DOM class in Scheduler, Gantt and the unchanged Board basic layout. The wrapped Gantt toolbar was 114 px tall and split Day and Week across rows. For the shipping layout, keep that zoom pair together and inspect the chart’s remaining height.

`scheduler/meridian` is the eighteenth entry: its top strip is a custom masthead, and its manifest offers one dark theme. Its supported palette and control placement need a separate decision. Refresh the directory census when the remaining planning leaves merge. This is rollout evidence; the production integration still depends on #21705.
